countries.notes: Geometry retained; properties reduced to English name, ISO_A3_EH with ADM0_A3 fallback, and label coordinates. Approximate boundaries, not an authoritative statement of sovereignty. Small countries may be omitted.

earth.notes: Original overview tiles at levels 0–2; not live satellite imagery.

statistics.notes: Fetched at runtime. Current calendar year and previous five years queried. Default is newest year with at least 80 mapped countries reporting. Never substitutes a different year for a missing country. Rankings cover mapped countries with figures only. Cached data carries its original retrieval timestamp. Provider metadata contains its last update date.
